subject: Onboarding/offboarding evidence: background checks + training logs
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@evergreenhealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: SOC2.request@evergreenhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Evidence request: onboarding/offboarding background checks + training logs

Hi Markus,

We're preparing for Evergreen Health's SOC 2 scoping and need documentation for personnel controls covering new hires and leavers for the last 18 months. Specifically:
- A redacted index of background checks (date, role, result code) and chain-of-custody that shows vendor handoff
- Training completion logs for Security Awareness + Data Handling for all engineers and product staff
- Offboarding access revocation audit (last 12 months) showing deprovision timestamps

Could you provide the redacted artifacts or grant auditor access to a read-only folder by COB 2026-11-23? If any items are restricted we can accept a signed attestation plus evidence samples.

Thanks,

Audrey Chen
Security Assurance Manager
Evergreen Health

Attachment: none

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: onboarding/offboarding background checks + training logs

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble this. Initial plan:
- I'll export a redacted index of background checks and include vendor receipts (attachment: background_checks_index.csv). Sensitive PII will be redacted.
- Maya will export the training roster (attachment: training_roster_q3.pdf) and map completion timestamps.
- Laura will pull the offboarding revocation audit (offboarding_revocation_audit.xlsx) and confirm timezones.

Two quick clarifying questions:
1) For chain-of-custody, do you need original signed PDFs from the vendor or an internal audit log showing vendor transfer events? (we can provide both if needed)
2) Are sample artifacts (3 hires + 3 leavers) sufficient, or do you require the full 18-month dataset in the folder for auditor review?

We'll upload to a read-only drive folder and post the link when ready — target EOD 2026-11-22.

—Markus
VP, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: background_checks_index.csv; training_roster_q3.pdf

From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@evergreenhealth.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: SOC2.request@evergreenhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-19T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: onboarding/offboarding background checks + training logs

Thanks Markus — that timeline works.
1) Chain-of-custody: auditor prefers vendor-signed PDFs where available; if not possible, an internal transfer log with timestamps is acceptable.
2) For the initial review please upload the full 18-month index plus the six sample artifacts (3 hires/3 leavers). If anything in the dataset is redacted beyond names/SSNs, please note why.

Also please add a short readme in the Drive folder outlining who to contact for any follow-ups (name, email, phone) and the data retention policy in effect for these documents.

I've opened a Jira internal ticket on our side: https://jira.evergreenhealth.com/browse/SEC-4172

Best,
Audrey
